declare @usedEI char(1), @q nvarchar(4000), @$pEI char(13), @$cEI tinyint, @eiStatus char(1), @eiAutoGenAnnouncement varchar(32)
select @usedEI = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_sd_hddt'

select @usedEI = isnull(@usedEI, '0'), @eiAutoGenAnnouncement = case when isnull(@eiAutoGenAnnouncement, '0') = '1' then '1' else '0' end
